critique: The snowflake sprites, black background, varied 3D orientations, and prominent large flakes fit the intended Large Snow 3D character well. Frame t1 is especially close to a spacious large-flake composition. By t4, however, the particle population has accumulated into a substantially busier field, with many small/dark flakes and several oversized edge flakes competing with the intended clean, sparse large-snow silhouette.

suggestions.why: Reduce the emission rate so the mature t4 frame contains fewer accumulated flakes while retaining a clearly active falling-snow motion.
Shorten particle lifetime to further prevent dense temporal buildup at later frames and keep the visual dominated by isolated large flakes.
